title: RFC Frontmatter
description: JSON Schema 2020-12 for Groundwork RFC frontmatter (rfc.md YAML header). Derived from hooks/rfc.mjs validateFrontmatter.
$comment: Invariants deliberately NOT covered by this schema: (1) legal status TRANSITIONS — a directed graph (draft→review→accepted→…), not expressible in JSON Schema; (2) body_digest correctness — SHA-256 of the rendered body, checked at review+ statuses by rfc.mjs at runtime; (3) manifest freshness — the <!-- rfc:manifest --> block in rfc.md is a generated index, verified separately; (4) spec_delta target existence on disk — whether each target path actually exists is a filesystem check, not a schema check; (5) cross-field constraint: accepted_by must be 'human' when classification is 'spec_change' — requires if/then logic beyond the enum; (6) supersedes uid referential integrity — whether each uid in supersedes[] names an existing RFC.

schema.description: RFC document schema version. 1 = legacy single-file layout; 2 = multi-file layout with sections/ and tasks.yaml sidecar.

uid.description: Globally unique RFC identifier. Format: R-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXX where XXXXXX is 6 uppercase alphanumeric characters.

ordinal.description: Sequential RFC number within the project (1-based).

slug.description: URL-safe kebab-case identifier derived from the RFC title.

status.description: Current lifecycle status. Legal transitions are enforced by rfc.mjs at runtime, not by this schema.

classification.description: RFC impact class. spec_change requires human acceptance; tactical may be advisor-accepted.

created.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the RFC was created.

updated.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the RFC frontmatter was last modified.

accepted_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the RFC was accepted, or null if not yet accepted.

accepted_by.description: Who accepted the RFC. 'human' or 'advisor', or null if not yet accepted. spec_change classification requires 'human'.

supersedes.description: Array of RFC uids that this RFC supersedes (may be empty).

superseded_by.description: UID of the RFC that supersedes this one, or null if not superseded.

body_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the rendered RFC body. Stamped when status transitions to 'review'. Null on drafts.

spec_delta.description: Ordered list of spec changes this RFC proposes. Each entry names a file and the operation applied to it.

op.description: Change type, using the Keep a Changelog v1.1.0 vocabulary (full published set). The prior bespoke enum (add|modify|supersede|remove) was replaced by STD7 in a hard cutover: add→Added, modify→Changed, remove→Removed, supersede→Deprecated with the replacement pointer moved into `description`.

target.description: Repo-relative path of the spec file affected. Whether the path exists on disk is not validated here.

description.description: Human-readable description of the change. Named per OpenAPI Overlay field conventions (renamed from `note` by STD7).

links.description: Freeform map of related links (e.g. GitHub issues, PRs). May be absent or empty.

tasks.description: Legacy: inline task list for single-file RFCs (schema 1). Multi-file RFCs (schema 2) use a tasks.yaml sidecar instead. Validated by rfc.mjs when present but not fully constrained here.
